abilities.name: Tidebringer
abilities.text: All squares not in an opponent's Back Row are considered your Back Row. This fighter cannot Move or be relocated out of your Back Row.

abilities.name: Lash Out
abilities.text: After this fighter Moves or is relocated, destroy target adjacent X, where X is the number of squares this fighter has Moved or been relocated out of this turn.

abilities.name: Usherance
abilities.text: During your turn, after a fighter enters a square adjacent to this fighter, you may relocate that fighter 1 square.

abilities.name: Depth Charge
abilities.text: Destroy target enemy I or II in your Back Row that is not in an opponent's Gates. Relocate this fighter to that square if it is now unoccupied.
